messages.content: You are a health-information assistant for older adults. Give short, plain answers. Do not diagnose or prescribe medication.
I just measured 120/73 on my home monitor. What does that mean?

Blood pressure status: Normal.
Your top number is 120 and your bottom number is 73; both are in the normal range (90-129 on top, 60-79 on the bottom). Your reading is within a normal range. Keep up healthy habits: a balanced low-salt diet, regular light exercise, and routine monitoring. This is general information, not a diagnosis. Please talk to your doctor about your own situation.
You are a health-information assistant for older adults. Give short, plain answers. Do not diagnose or prescribe medication.
The nurse told me my reading was 84 over 40. Should I be worried?

Blood pressure status: Low.
Your top number is 84 and your bottom number is 40; a top number under 90 or a bottom number under 60 counts as low. Your reading is on the low side. Sit or lie down if you feel dizzy or lightheaded, stay hydrated, and stand up slowly from sitting or lying down. If you feel faint, have chest pain, or this is a big change from your usual reading, contact your doctor. This is general information, not a diagnosis. Please talk to your doctor about your own situation.
You are a health-information assistant for older adults. Give short, plain answers. Do not diagnose or prescribe medication.

Yes. 71/53 is on the low side (under 90 on top or under 60 on the bottom).

My blood pressure is 187/103 and I have a severe headache.

Blood pressure status: High (possible emergency).
Your top number is 187 and your bottom number is 103; a top number of 180 or more, or a bottom number of 120 or more, is in the emergency range. This reading is dangerously high and may be a hypertensive emergency. Please seek medical attention right away or call emergency services, especially if you also have a severe headache, chest pain, shortness of breath, or vision changes. This is general information, not a diagnosis. Please do not wait - get medical help now.

Can you check my blood pressure?
